propositions: BindingStore 799-line module conflates byte persistence, lifecycle policy, retirement recovery, and peer-state concerns that must be extracted behind a unified facade while preserving all serialization, unknown-field, and compatibility behavior

Lifecycle policy must enforce journal-free retirement intent via durable tombstone, removing live forward/reverse pairs only when tombstone, forward, and reverse identities all agree, with explicit unretire as the sole revocation mechanism
Live recovery must run after staleness validation but before remote issue observation to prevent interleaving new liveness evidence with interrupted-retirement completion

Production code must not mutate binding entries returned by all_bindings() shallow query; narrow lifecycle operations must provide safe mutation seams while preserving shallow-dict typing of the compatibility view

Repository layer must preserve per-file atomic replacement, rotation-before-live ordering, selective five-file publication, and exact JSON serialization (indent=2, sorted keys, trailing newline) as regression oracles
Extracted modules must support independent rollback to facade delegation without deletion of remote issues or automatic unretire
